rows.note: SCIAD; phases out between $40,001 and $95,000 of federal AGI.

rows.label: Standard deduction: Head of household
rows.note: SCIAD; phases out between $60,001 and $142,500 of federal AGI.

rows.label: Standard deduction: Married filing jointly
rows.note: SCIAD; phases out between $80,001 and $190,000 of federal AGI.

rows.label: Standard deduction: Qualifying surviving spouse
rows.note: SCIAD; same as married filing jointly.

sections.title: South Carolina corporate income and franchise taxes

rows.label: Corporate income tax rate
rows.note: Flat 5% on South Carolina taxable income of corporations.

source.title: South Carolina Code of Laws, Title 12 Chapter 6, Section 12-6-530 (Corporate income tax)

rows.label: Bank tax rate (on entire net income)
rows.note: Banks pay a 4.5% bank tax instead of the corporate income tax.

rows.value: $15 plus $1 per $1,000 of capital stock and paid-in or capital surplus
